independent_unit: candidate station; bands/acquisitions/5x20 readings are not independent replicates; review spatial overlap before inference

convolution.integration: trapezoidal on union knots; interpolate only adjacent finite ASD samples <=1 nm; no extrapolation
convolution.invalid_policy: reject if nonfinite or missing/noisy interval intersects positive SRF; do not bridge, extrapolate, replace with zero, or silently renormalize truncated bands
convolution.version_sensitivity: v5 separate reference after release; no convolution in amendment

spatial.support: confirmed field area first; primary containing 10m pixel only when same sampled footprint supported; fixed 3x3 neighborhood sensitivity, never post hoc value optimization
spatial.coarse_bands: B01 native60m, B05/B06/B07/B8A native20m require documented homogeneous footprint of same support; 10m ACOLITE resampling does not create resolution
spatial.registration: grid-aligned B02/B03/B04 with integer crop offset; image-to-ground registration unmeasured; no shifts fitted to ASD reflectance
spatial.resampling: none for primary; area-weighted same-boundary aggregation only under agreed coarse-support contract; nearest neighbor for categorical masks
spatial.time: same day insufficient; record UTC interval and tide/exposure at acquisition and field survey before enabling

masks.support_rule: all primary support pixels must pass common masks; no partial-footprint averaging
masks.acolite_invalid: NaN/nonfinite; no provided l2_flags on March27; l2w_mask=False
masks.defect_masks: native MSK_QUALIT/MSK_DETFOO still require decoding and extraction-stage verification
masks.water: SCL6 not automatically discarded; exposure/optical quantity must be established independently
masks.negative_reflectance: retain finite values after quality masks; flag, do not clip to improve fit

statistics_handoff.status: schema completed as held design; not an executable released extraction

sets.P_b: reference + both methods + common physical/full-support QA pass for a band
sets.P_star: intersection P_b across fixed B02/B03/B04; same targets/reference in both facets

weights.normalization: identical normalized weights for both corrections; extraction weights separate; RMSE sqrt(weighted squared error)

required_inventory: targets and original frozen units retained/lost
complete_case_coverage.rule: all planned classes/sites must be represented and exposure/QA loss assessed; unknown types stay unknown; a primary-population claim requires a dated metadata-based justification; no automatic numerical percentage cutoff
complete_case_coverage.empty_P_star: NA pooled metrics with reason, per-band valid tables only
complete_case_coverage.unrepresentative_P_star: subset description only; withhold primary-population ranking
complete_case_coverage.fallback: dated Charles amendment before replacement display/estimand; no dropping bands/imputation/supplementary substitution to populate primary

statistics_handoff.grouping: freeze graph before errors; never split components by method/band/type or after exclusion; no final independent-n yet
statistics_handoff.tiers: G=0 no estimate; G=1-4 descriptive; G=5-19 unit contrasts + leave-one-unit-out; no inferential intervals/p-values/bootstrap for current <=8 primary targets
statistics_handoff.contrast: ACOLITE minus operational L2A MAE; signed bias and RMSE companion descriptive measures after release
statistics_handoff.ecological_threshold: required for ecological-importance/equivalence claim, not descriptive discrepancy
sensitivity: supplied v4 versus separately hashed official v5
prespecified registration +/-1 pixel and footprint alternatives, own support graph
equal-target sensitivity if unit sizes differ; distinct estimand
QA-grouped sensitivity if materially relevant; not default radiometric merge

null_semantics: null unknown/not evaluated, never zero/pass; booleans false while held
schema_checks: unique normalized keys/IDs; all foreign keys; 165 ledger rows retained
later extraction: numerical contributor weights sum to 1 on fixed full support; common identity, per-method/reference/physical/paired/complete-spectrum status
unknown essential support/QA/grouping blocks extraction; no null passed/defaulted
common complete sets and complete-case loss reconciliation before error inspection
